newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen staying out of open market on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen staying out of open market on Friday.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to stay out of the open market on Friday, as the weekend add need was satisfied on Thursday, analysts said.
The Fed added temporary reserves to the banking system on Thursday through 14-day fixed system repurchase agreements.

Analysts said the Fed faces a $7-8 billion add need for the rest of the maintenance period, ending Wednesday. But with federal funds well below the 5-1/4 percent target rate, there is little need for the Fed to add reserves before Monday, they said.
Fed funds opened at 5-1/8 percent, and have traded at that level thus far today.
